mapper.sql: risk_type_id, risk_type_code, risk_type_name, risk_category, risk_description, impact_level, probability_level, risk_level, control_measures, monitoring_indicators, response_strategy, responsible_department, responsible_person, review_frequency, last_review_date, next_review_date, is_enabled, org_id, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY risk_level DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_enabled = 1 AND risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') ORDER BY risk_level DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_enabled = 1 AND risk_level = 'CRITICAL' ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_enabled = 1 AND (next_review_date IS NULL OR next_review_date <= CURDATE()) ORDER BY next_review_date ASC

SELECT risk_category as category, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 END) as enabledCount FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY risk_category ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT impact_level as level, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 END) as enabledCount FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY impact_level ORDER BY CASE impact_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT probability_level as level, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 END) as enabledCount FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY probability_level ORDER BY CASE probability_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT risk_level as level, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 END) as enabledCount FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 END) as enabledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 0 THEN 1 END) as disabledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 END) as mediumCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'LOW' THEN 1 END) as lowCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN next_review_date IS NULL OR next_review_date <= CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as needReviewCount FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId}

SELECT risk_category as category, risk_level as level, COUNT(*) as count FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_enabled = 1 GROUP BY risk_category, risk_level ORDER BY risk_category, CASE risk_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT
DATE(create_time) as period
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%u') as period
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as period
CONCAT(YEAR(create_time), '-Q', QUARTER(create_time)) as period
YEAR(create_time) as period
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as period
, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 END) as mediumCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'LOW' THEN 1 END) as lowCount FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT rt.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE risk_type_id = rt.risk_type_id) as assessmentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE risk_type_id = rt.risk_type_id) as monitoringCount FROM gt_risk_type_definition rt WHERE rt.risk_type_id = #{riskTypeId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalRiskTypes, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 END) as enabledRiskTypes, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalRiskTypes, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highRiskTypes, AVG(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 WHEN risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN risk_level = 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN risk_level = 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as avgRiskScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN next_review_date IS NULL OR next_review_date <= CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as overdueReviews FROM gt_risk_type_definition WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
SELECT operation_type, operation_content, operation_user, operation_time FROM gt_risk_type_history WHERE risk_type_id = #{riskTypeId} ORDER BY operation_time DESC

SELECT 'ASSESSMENT' as dataType, COUNT(*) as count FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE risk_type_id = #{riskTypeId} UNION ALL SELECT 'MONITORING' as dataType, COUNT(*) as count FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE risk_type_id = #{riskTypeId}

SELECT rt.risk_type_id, rt.risk_type_code, rt.risk_type_name, rt.risk_level, CASE WHEN rt.next_review_date IS NULL THEN 'NO_REVIEW_DATE' WHEN rt.next_review_date < CURDATE() THEN 'OVERDUE_REVIEW' WHEN rt.next_review_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 'UPCOMING_REVIEW' ELSE 'NORMAL' END as alertType, rt.next_review_date FROM gt_risk_type_definition rt WHERE rt.org_id = #{orgId} AND rt.is_enabled = 1
AND (
rt.next_review_date IS NULL
rt.next_review_date < CURDATE()
rt.next_review_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
rt.risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')
)
ORDER BY rt.risk_level DESC, rt.next_review_date ASC

#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT rt.risk_type_id, rt.risk_type_code, rt.risk_type_name, rt.risk_category, rt.risk_level, COUNT(ra.assessment_id) as assessmentCount, COUNT(rm.monitoring_id) as monitoringCount, AVG(DATEDIFF(ra.completion_date, ra.assessment_date)) as avgAssessmentDays, COUNT(CASE WHEN ra.assessment_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completedAssessments, COUNT(CASE WHEN rm.monitoring_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeMonitorings FROM gt_risk_type_definition rt LEFT JOIN gt_risk_assessment ra ON rt.risk_type_id = ra.risk_type_id LEFT JOIN gt_risk_monitoring rm ON rt.risk_type_id = rm.risk_type_id WHERE rt.org_id = #{orgId} AND rt.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY rt.risk_type_id, rt.risk_type_code, rt.risk_type_name, rt.risk_category, rt.risk_level ORDER BY rt.risk_level DESC, assessmentCount DESC

SELECT rt.risk_type_id, rt.risk_type_code, rt.risk_type_name, rt.risk_level, CASE WHEN rt.risk_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(rt.risk_description) > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasDetailedDescription, CASE WHEN rt.control_measures IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(rt.control_measures) > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasControlMeasures, CASE WHEN rt.monitoring_indicators IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(rt.monitoring_indicators) > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasMonitoringIndicators, CASE WHEN rt.responsible_person IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasResponsiblePerson, CASE WHEN rt.next_review_date IS NOT NULL AND rt.next_review_date > CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasValidReviewDate FROM gt_risk_type_definition rt WHERE rt.org_id = #{orgId} AND rt.is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY rt.risk_level DESC, rt.create_time DESC

SELECT rt.risk_category, rt.risk_level, COUNT(*) as riskTypeCount, COUNT(ra.assessment_id) as totalAssessments, COUNT(rm.monitoring_id) as totalMonitorings, AVG(ra.assessment_cost) as avgAssessmentCost, AVG(rm.monitoring_cost) as avgMonitoringCost, SUM(ra.assessment_cost) as totalAssessmentCost, SUM(rm.monitoring_cost) as totalMonitoringCost FROM gt_risk_type_definition rt LEFT JOIN gt_risk_assessment ra ON rt.risk_type_id = ra.risk_type_id AND ra.assessment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} LEFT JOIN gt_risk_monitoring rm ON rt.risk_type_id = rm.risk_type_id AND rm.monitoring_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE rt.org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY rt.risk_category, rt.risk_level ORDER BY totalAssessmentCost DESC, totalMonitoringCost DESC
